headline: India's biggest software exporters are set to beat global chip stocks by the widest weekly margin since 2004 as the AI rally unwinds.
score_reason: Niche regional rotation story from one outlet; facts support the pool score.
importance_line: Fund managers and investors in Indian IT firms see a rotation out of AI chips, but a week's move is short and analysts quoted still see weak growth ahead.
summary: Bloomberg reports that an index of India's largest software exporters has risen more than 10% this week while a global chip-stock gauge fell 7.4%, the biggest weekly gap since 2004, as AI shares tumbled on slowing revenue growth and financing worries. Rajat Agarwal, an Asia strategist at Societe Generale, expects foreign investors to look at Indian IT stocks, though Morgan Stanley analysts say the sector lacks near-term catalysts and the index is still down about 17% this year.
